hollow_blackthorn (1)

THE HOLLOW AT BLACKTHORN A mouse-driven, 2D point-and-click horror adventure.

Requirements: Python 3.10+ pygame 2.5+

Run: python -m pip install pygame python hollow_blackthorn.py

 190class SceneAudio:
 191    """Crossfade distinct looped room ambience with independent SFX channels."""
 192
 193    FADE_SECONDS = 1.8
 194    VOLUME = 0.67
 195
 196    def __init__(self):
 197        self.enabled = AUDIO_ENABLED
 198        self.channels = [pygame.mixer.Channel(4), pygame.mixer.Channel(5)] if self.enabled else []
 199        self.music_channel = pygame.mixer.Channel(6) if self.enabled else None
 200        self.active_slot = None
 201        self.fading_slot = None
 202        self.active_scene = None
 203        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
 204        self.muted = False
 205
 206    def enter(self, scene):
 207        if not self.enabled or scene == self.active_scene:
 208            return
 209        sound = AMBIENCE.get(scene)
 210        if self.music_channel is not None and MUSIC_BED is not None and not self.music_channel.get_busy():
 211            self.music_channel.set_volume(0.0 if self.muted else 0.095)
 212            self.music_channel.play(MUSIC_BED, loops=-1)
 213        if sound is None:
 214            self.stop()
 215            return
 216
 217        next_slot = 0 if self.active_slot is None else 1 - self.active_slot
 218        self.fading_slot = self.active_slot
 219        self.active_slot = next_slot
 220        self.active_scene = scene
 221        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
 222        channel = self.channels[next_slot]
 223        channel.stop()
 224        channel.set_volume(0.0)
 225        channel.play(sound, loops=-1)
 226
 227        # For a fresh game, start the first room gently instead of abruptly.
 228        if self.fading_slot is None:
 229            self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
 230
 231    def update(self, seconds):
 232        if self.active_slot is None:
 233            return
 234        self.fade_elapsed = min(self.FADE_SECONDS, self.fade_elapsed + seconds)
 235        amount = self.fade_elapsed / self.FADE_SECONDS
 236        target_volume = 0.0 if self.muted else self.VOLUME
 237        if self.music_channel is not None:
 238            self.music_channel.set_volume(0.0 if self.muted else 0.095)
 239        self.channels[self.active_slot].set_volume(target_volume * amount)
 240        if self.fading_slot is not None:
 241            other = self.channels[self.fading_slot]
 242            other.set_volume(target_volume * (1.0 - amount))
 243            if amount >= 1.0:
 244                other.stop()
 245                self.fading_slot = None
 246
 247    def toggle_mute(self):
 248        self.muted = not self.muted
 249        # Apply the change immediately, including to sound being crossfaded.
 250        self.update(0.0)
 251
 252    def stop(self):
 253        for channel in self.channels:
 254            channel.stop()
 255        if self.music_channel is not None:
 256            self.music_channel.stop()
 257        self.active_slot = None
 258        self.fading_slot = None
 259        self.active_scene = None
 260        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
 261
 262
 263SCENE_AUDIO = SceneAudio()

 556# ----------------------------- Helpers ---------------------------------------
 557def draw_text(surface, text, x, y, font=FONT, color=PALE):
 558    surface.blit(font.render(str(text), True, color), (x, y))
 559
 560def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
 561    words = text.split()
 562    if not words:
 563        return [""]
 564    lines, line = [], ""
 565    for word in words:
 566        test = word if not line else line + " " + word
 567        if font.size(test)[0] <= max_width:
 568            line = test
 569        else:
 570            if line:
 571                lines.append(line)
 572            line = word
 573    if line:
 574        lines.append(line)
 575    return lines
 576
 577def draw_wrapped(surface, text, rect, font=FONT, color=PALE, line_gap=3, max_lines=None):
 578    y = rect.y
 579    count = 0
 580    for line in wrap_text(text, font, rect.width):
 581        if max_lines is not None and count >= max_lines:
 582            break
 583        surface.blit(font.render(line, True, color), (rect.x, y))
 584        y += font.get_linesize() + line_gap
 585        count += 1
 586    return y
 587
 588def panel(surface, rect, fill=PANEL, border=LINE, radius=6):
 589    pygame.draw.rect(surface, fill, rect, border_radius=radius)
 590    pygame.draw.rect(surface, border, rect, 1, border_radius=radius)
 591
 592def button(surface, rect, label, hovered=False, enabled=True, font=FONT):
 593    fill = (15, 45, 59) if hovered else (7, 24, 35)
 594    edge = CYAN if hovered else LINE
 595    if not enabled:
 596        fill, edge = (8, 15, 21), (43, 59, 66)
 597    pygame.draw.rect(surface, fill, rect, border_radius=5)
 598    pygame.draw.rect(surface, edge, rect, 1, border_radius=5)
 599    lines = wrap_text(label, font, rect.width - 16)
 600    total_h = len(lines) * font.get_linesize()
 601    y = rect.centery - total_h // 2
 602    for line in lines:
 603        img = font.render(line, True, PALE if enabled else MUTED)
 604        surface.blit(img, (rect.centerx - img.get_width() // 2, y))
 605        y += font.get_linesize()

 608def new_popup(title, text, color=CYAN):
 609    return {"title": title, "text": text, "color": color, "ttl": 240}

 611def new_game(character_name):
 612    SCENE_AUDIO.enter("road")
 613    return {
 614        "character": character_name,
 615        "scene": "road", "decisions":SCENES["road"]["limit"],
 616        "room_remaining":{"road":SCENES["road"]["limit"]},
 617        "room_actions":{}, "used_actions":set(),
 618        "back_stack":[], "navigation_open":False, "map_open":False,
 619        "inventory":[], "clues":set(), "flags":set(),
 620        "health":100, "noise":0, "pursuit_active":False,
 621        "message":"Search the car before entering the house; the woods are still.",
 622        "hover_hint":"", "game_over":False, "ending":"", "ending_title":"",
 623        "visited":{"road"},
 624        "popup":new_popup("The Blackthorn Gate", "Something moved among the trees. Search the car first if you need supplies.", GOLD),
 625        "last_action":None, "threat":0,
 626        "encounter":None, "encounter_pending":None, "encounter_delay":0.0,
 627        "encounter_warning":None, "encounter_warned":False,
 628        "encountered":set(), "actions_in_scene":0, "killer_visible":False,
 629        "inventory_message":"Click items to inspect them. Bandages heal and are consumed.",

 633def current_character(state):
 634    return CHARACTERS[state["character"]]
 635
 636def set_feedback(state, title, text, color=CYAN):
 637    state["message"] = text
 638    state["popup"] = new_popup(title, text, color)
 639
 640def queue_encounter(state, scene, delay=3.0, warning=None):
 641    if state["game_over"] or scene in state["encountered"] or state["encounter"]:
 642        return False
 643    if state["scene"] != scene or state.get("encounter_pending") == scene:
 644        return False
 645    state["encounter_pending"] = scene
 646    state["encounter_delay"] = float(delay)
 647    state["encounter_warning"] = warning
 648    state["encounter_warned"] = False
 649    # Keep the interaction result visible before warning the player.
 650    return True
 651
 652
 653def enter_scene(state, scene_id, feedback=None, backtracking=False):
 654    if scene_id not in SCENES or scene_id == state["scene"]:
 655        return
 656    old_scene=state["scene"]
 657    already_visited = scene_id in state["visited"]
 658    state["room_remaining"][old_scene]=state["decisions"]
 659    state["room_actions"][old_scene]=state["actions_in_scene"]
 660    if not backtracking:
 661        state["back_stack"].append(old_scene)
 662    state["scene"]=scene_id
 663    state["navigation_open"]=False
 664    state["map_open"] = False
 665    state["encounter"]=None
 666    state["encounter_pending"]=None
 667    state["encounter_delay"]=0.0
 668    state["encounter_warning"]=None
 669    state["encounter_warned"]=False
 670    state["killer_visible"]=False
 671    state["decisions"]=state["room_remaining"].setdefault(scene_id,SCENES[scene_id]["limit"])
 672    state["actions_in_scene"]=state["room_actions"].get(scene_id,0)
 673    state["visited"].add(scene_id)
 674    SCENE_AUDIO.enter(scene_id)
 675    if feedback is None:
 676        feedback = "You return to " + SCENES[scene_id]["title"] + "." if already_visited else "You enter " + SCENES[scene_id]["title"] + "."
 677    if already_visited:
 678        feedback += f" Decisions here remain at {state['decisions']}; used actions do not refresh."
 679    set_feedback(state, SCENES[scene_id]["title"], feedback, GOLD)
 680    if not already_visited and state["pursuit_active"] and scene_id in ("landing","nursery","study"):
 681        queue_encounter(state,scene_id,delay=4.6,
 682            warning="The staircase groans behind you. Slow, dragging steps are following you into this room. Hide or prepare for the Watcher.")
 683    elif not already_visited and scene_id=="basement" and state["noise"]>=4:
 684        queue_encounter(state,scene_id,delay=4.0,
 685            warning="Your earlier noise echoes down the service shafts. A metal scrape answers from the dark.")
 686    elif not already_visited and scene_id=="yard" and state["noise"]>=5:
 687        queue_encounter(state,scene_id,delay=5.0,
 688            warning="A shadow slips along the wet wall outside. Your noisy passage through the house was not forgotten.")
 689
 690
 691def go_back(state):
 692    if state.get("encounter"):
 693        return
 694    if not state["back_stack"]:
 695        set_feedback(state,"No Previous Room","This is the first location. Use PATHS to move into the estate.",MUTED)
 696        return
 697    dest=state["back_stack"].pop()
 698    enter_scene(state,dest,backtracking=True,feedback="You retrace your route, watching for familiar hazards.")
 699
 700
 701def use_route(state, route_id):
 702    if state["game_over"] or state["encounter"]:
 703        return
 704    route_ids = [key for key, _ in ROUTES[state["scene"]]]
 705    if route_id not in route_ids:
 706        return
 707    target=route_id
 708    if route_id in ("landing_quiet","landing_loud"):
 709        target="landing"
 710        if route_id=="landing_loud":
 711            state["noise"]+=3
 712            state["flags"].add("stair_noise")
 713            state["pursuit_active"]=True
 714            warning="You sprint up the old stairs. Each step cracks like a gunshot; footsteps start climbing behind you."
 715        else:
 716            if "stairs_are_noisy" in state["clues"] or current_character(state)["traits"]["Stealth"]>=2:
 717                warning="You keep to the quiet edges of the stairs. Nothing follows you up."
 718            else:
 719                state["noise"]+=1
 720                warning="You try to creep, but a weak tread groans. The darkness below seems to listen."
 721        enter_scene(state,target,feedback=warning)
 722        return
 723    if route_id=="chapel_secret":
 724        target="chapel"
 725        if "passage_open" not in state["flags"]:
 726            set_feedback(state,"Hidden Passage Shut","You have to discover the bookcase catch before you can take this passage.",MUTED)
 727            return
 728    if state["scene"]=="basement" and route_id=="yard":
 729        if not ({"generator_disabled","panel_open"}&state["flags"]) and not ({"Maintenance Log","Brass Key"}&set(state["inventory"])):
 730            set_feedback(state,"The Rear Door Is Locked","You need the maintenance code, a brass key, or the generator override to open it.",MUTED)
 731            return
 732        if "Brass Key" in state["inventory"] and "Maintenance Log" not in state["inventory"] and "generator_disabled" not in state["flags"]:
 733            remove_item(state,"Brass Key")
 734    if state["scene"]=="nursery" and route_id=="chapel" and "nursery_diary" not in state["clues"]:
 735        set_feedback(state,"Narrow Staircase","The panel door has no handle. The diary may reveal its latch.",MUTED)
 736        return
 737    if state["scene"]=="yard" and route_id=="basement" and "yard" not in state["visited"]:
 738        return
 739    enter_scene(state,target)
 740

 742def end_game(state, ending, fatal=False, title=None):
 743    state["game_over"] = True
 744    state["ending"] = ending
 745    state["ending_title"] = title or ("GAME OVER" if fatal else "ESCAPED BLACKTHORN")
 746    state["message"] = ending
 747    state["popup"] = None
 748    state["navigation_open"] = False
 749    state["map_open"] = False
 750    state["encounter"] = None
 751    state["killer_visible"] = False
 752    if fatal:
 753        state["health"] = 0
 754

 756def spend_decision(state):
 757    if state["decisions"] <= 0:
 758        set_feedback(state,"No Decisions Left","This room is exhausted. Use PATHS or BACK to explore other places; revisiting will not restore decisions.",GOLD)
 759        return False
 760    state["decisions"]-=1
 761    state["room_remaining"][state["scene"]]=state["decisions"]
 762    return True
 763

 765def add_item(state, item):
 766    if item not in state["inventory"]:
 767        state["inventory"].append(item)
 768
 769def remove_item(state, item):
 770    if item in state["inventory"]:
 771        state["inventory"].remove(item)
 772        return True
 773    return False
 774
 775def use_item(state, item):
 776    if item not in state["inventory"]:
 777        return
 778    if item == "Bandage":
 779        if state["health"] >= 100:
 780            set_feedback(state, "Not Needed", "You're unhurt. Save the bandage for a real injury.", GOLD)
 781        else:
 782            healed = min(30, 100-state["health"])
 783            state["health"] += healed
 784            remove_item(state, item)
 785            set_feedback(state, "Bandage Used", f"You dress the wound and recover {healed} health. The bandage is removed from inventory.", GREEN)
 786    elif item == "Victim's Note":
 787        set_feedback(state, "Victim's Note", "He hears the stairs. Don't use them when the house is quiet. The handwriting ends in a desperate scrawl.", CYAN)
 788    elif item == "Maintenance Log":
 789        set_feedback(state, "Maintenance Log", "The basement override code is 0417. Handwritten dates suggest someone carefully counted each disappearance.", CYAN)
 790    elif item == "Brass Key" and state["scene"] == "basement":
 791        use_route(state, "yard")
 792    else:
 793        set_feedback(state, "Inventory", f"{item} is ready. Some items are consumed automatically when you use them in an encounter or on a lock.", MUTED)
 794
 795def add_clue(state, clue):
 796    state["clues"].add(clue)

 824def trigger_encounter(state, scene=None):
 825    scene = scene or state["scene"]
 826    if state["game_over"] or scene in state["encountered"]:
 827        return
 828    state["encountered"].add(scene)
 829    state["encounter"] = scene
 830    state["encounter_pending"] = None
 831    state["encounter_delay"] = 0.0
 832    state["encounter_warning"] = None
 833    state["encounter_warned"] = False
 834    state["navigation_open"] = False
 835    state["map_open"] = False
 836    state["killer_visible"] = True
 837    state["threat"] += 1
 838    state["popup"] = None
 839    state["message"] = ENCOUNTERS[scene][1]

 842def hurt(state, damage, narrative):
 843    state["health"] = max(0, state["health"]-damage)
 844    state["flags"].add("injured")
 845    if damage:
 846        state["threat"] += 1
 847    if state["health"] <= 0:
 848        end_game(state, narrative + " You collapse before reaching safety.", True)
 849    else:
 850        set_feedback(state, "INJURED  -" + str(damage) + " HP", narrative, RED)

 853def encounter_choice(state, index):
 854    scene = state.get("encounter")
 855    if scene is None or index not in (0, 1, 2):
 856        return
 857    c = current_character(state)["traits"]
 858    inv = state["inventory"]
 859    state["encounter"] = None
 860    state["killer_visible"] = False
 861    state["flags"].add("killer_alerted")
 862    damage = 0
 863    note = ""
 864    if scene == "road":
 865        if index == 0:
 866            damage = 0 if c["Stealth"] >= 2 else 12
 867            note = "You crouch low behind the car as the Watcher drifts by. Its blade brushes the metal inches from your face." if not damage else "The Watcher phases around the trunk and slashes your leg before slipping back into the rain."
 868        elif index == 1:
 869            damage = 8 if c["Strength"] >= 3 else 15
 870            note = "You sprint through the muddy gate. An icy blade catches your coat before the apparition thins into the storm."
 871        elif "Flashlight" in inv:
 872            remove_item(state, "Flashlight")
 873            note = "You flare the flashlight into its hollow mask. The battery dies, and the spectral figure peels apart into mist. The flashlight is gone."
 874        else:
 875            damage = 17
 876            note = "You reach for a flashlight you never found. The Watcher closes the gap and cuts your shoulder before vanishing into the trees."
 877    elif scene == "hall":
 878        if index == 0:
 879            damage = 0 if c["Stealth"] >= 2 else 14
 880            note = "You don't move. The Watcher studies you from the landing, then unravels into smoke upstairs." if not damage else "You shift your weight on a creaking floorboard. The Watcher charges and wounds your arm before fading from the staircase."
 881        elif index == 1:
 882            damage = 8 if c["Strength"] >= 3 else 24
 883            note = "You shoulder past the apparition toward the dining wing. Its blade glances off you before the figure scatters into ash-like vapor."
 884        else:
 885            damage = 0 if c["Perception"] >= 2 else 16
 886            note = "You find a narrow hiding space beside the stair rail and watch the ghost pass through the banister, then dissolve." if not damage else "You crouch in the wrong shadow. A spectral boot strikes your ribs before the Watcher flickers away."
 887    elif scene == "dining":
 888        if index == 0:
 889            damage = 0 if c["Stealth"] >= 2 else 17
 890            note = "You slide soundlessly under the table while the Watcher's hem drifts past inches away, then disappears." if not damage else "A chair snaps loudly beneath you. The Watcher reaches under the table and slices your calf before withdrawing into the dark."
 891        elif index == 1:
 892            damage = 3 if c["Strength"] >= 3 else 21
 893            note = "You topple a heavy chair into its path. It slows the specter long enough for you to escape, though a glancing blow opens your side."
 894        elif "Kitchen Knife" in inv:
 895            remove_item(state, "Kitchen Knife")
 896            note = "You block its strike with the kitchen knife. The blade snaps in two, and the ghost recoils into a blur of smoke. The knife is gone."
 897        else:
 898            damage = 25
 899            note = "You reach for a weapon you don't have. The Watcher drives you against the table before melting back into shadow."

1013def after_player_action(state, old_scene, old_decisions, action=None):
1014    if state["game_over"] or state["encounter"] or state["scene"]!=old_scene:
1015        return
1016    if state["decisions"]>=old_decisions:
1017        return
1018    scene=state["scene"]
1019    state["actions_in_scene"]+=1
1020    state["room_actions"][scene]=state["actions_in_scene"]
1021    state["used_actions"].add((scene,action))
1022    if scene in state["encountered"] or state.get("encounter_pending"):
1023        return
1024    if scene=="road" and state["actions_in_scene"]>=2:
1025        queue_encounter(state,scene,4.0,"The footprints stop at the tree line. Pale mist is gathering beyond your headlights; something is coming closer.")
1026    elif scene in ("hall","dining","study") and state["noise"]>=2 and state["actions_in_scene"]>=1:
1027        queue_encounter(state,scene,3.8,"Your earlier noise has traveled through the house. A slow scraping sound answers from the corridor.")
1028    elif scene=="nursery" and action=="nursery_music":
1029        queue_encounter(state,scene,3.4,"The music box starts playing by itself. Something cold is taking shape beside the cradle.")
1030    elif scene=="greenhouse" and (action=="greenhouse_heat" or state["noise"]>=4):
1031        queue_encounter(state,scene,3.5,"Condensation spreads in the shape of a handprint. The Watcher has heard you among the glass.")
1032    elif scene=="chapel" and action=="chapel_bell":
1033        queue_encounter(state,scene,3.6,"The bell reverberates deep below the chapel. A cold shape is climbing toward the sound.")
1034    elif scene=="crypt" and action=="crypt_coffin" and state["noise"]>=3:
1035        queue_encounter(state,scene,3.6,"The heavy lid echoes off the stone walls. The breathing sound comes from outside the crypt door.")
1036

1039# Exploration decisions are one-time, while navigation remains free and repeatable.
1040# A single action key is shared by the bottom card and its scene hotspot.
1041TRAVEL_ACTIONS = frozenset(("gate", "dining", "stairs", "steeldoor", "continue", "paths", "back"))
1042
1043
1044def decision_already_made(state, action):
1045    return (action not in TRAVEL_ACTIONS
1046            and (state["scene"], action) in state["used_actions"])
1047
1048
1049def show_decision_already_made(state, action):
1050    label = next((name for name, key in action_cards_for_scene(state) if key == action), None)
1051    if label is None:
1052        label = action.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
1053    set_feedback(
1054        state, "DECISION ALREADY MADE",
1055        f"You already chose '{label}' in this room. It stays marked in the room-decisions panel "
1056        "and cannot be repeated, even after returning here. No decision was spent.",
1057        MUTED,
1058    )
1059
1060def perform_action(state,action):
1061    if state["game_over"] or state.get("encounter"):
1062        return
1063    if action in ("continue","paths","stairs"):
1064        state["navigation_open"]=True
1065        state["map_open"] = False
1066        state["popup"]=None
1067        return
1068    if action=="map":
1069        state["map_open"] = not state.get("map_open", False)
1070        state["navigation_open"] = False
1071        state["popup"] = None
1072        return
1073    if action=="back":
1074        state["map_open"] = False
1075        go_back(state)
1076        return
1077    if action=="close_paths":
1078        state["navigation_open"]=False
1079        return
1080    if action=="close_map":
1081        state["map_open"] = False
1082        return
1083    if action.startswith("route:"):
1084        use_route(state,action.split(":",1)[1])
1085        return
1086    # Existing door hotspots remain clickable, but traveling is free.
1087    if action in ("gate","dining","steeldoor"):
1088        use_route(state,{"gate":"hall","dining":"dining","steeldoor":"yard"}[action])
1089        return
1090    if action=="watch_killer":
1091        return
1092    # Check the persistent action registry BEFORE deducting a decision.
1093    if decision_already_made(state, action):
1094        show_decision_already_made(state, action)
1095        return
1096    oldscene,olddec=state["scene"],state["decisions"]
1097    act(state,action)
1098    after_player_action(state,oldscene,olddec,action)
1099

1101def auto_advance(state):
1102    # The old six-room linear jump has been replaced by a path selection menu.
1103    state["navigation_open"]=True

1464def blit_cover(surface, image, rect):
1465    iw, ih = image.get_size()
1466    scale = max(rect.width / iw, rect.height / ih)
1467    new_size = (max(1, int(iw * scale)), max(1, int(ih * scale)))
1468    scaled = pygame.transform.smoothscale(image, new_size)
1469    sx = max(0, (scaled.get_width() - rect.width) // 2)
1470    sy = max(0, (scaled.get_height() - rect.height) // 2)
1471    surface.blit(scaled, rect.topleft, area=pygame.Rect(sx, sy, rect.width, rect.height))

1474def draw_portrait(surface, person, rect):
1475    img = PORTRAITS.get(person)
1476    if img:
1477        blit_cover(surface, img, rect)
1478    else:
1479        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (16, 37, 48), rect)
1480        draw_text(surface, person, rect.x+16, rect.y+rect.height//2, SMALL, GOLD)
1481    pygame.draw.rect(surface, LINE, rect, 1, border_radius=4)

1561def draw_hotspots(state):

1608def action_cards_for_scene(state):
1609    choices={
1610        "road":[("Inspect footprints","tracks"),("Search glove box","glovebox"),("Enter the estate","gate"),("Hide and listen","listen")],
1611        "hall":[("Read the note","read_note"),("Inspect portrait","portrait"),("Go to dining room","dining"),("Take staircase","stairs")],
1612        "dining":[("Search pantry","pantry"),("Check window","window"),("Read message","message"),("Search sideboard","sideboard")],
1613        "study":[("Read ledger","ledger"),("Inspect fuse panel","panel"),("Search bookcase","bookcase"),("Open desk drawer","drawer")],
1614        "basement":[("Inspect generator","generator"),("Try steel door","steeldoor"),("Count tally marks","tallies")],
1615        "yard":[("Break service gate","service_gate"),("Search shed","shed"),("Read footprints","yard_tracks")],
1616        "landing":[("Check floorboard","landing_floor"),("Inspect railing","landing_rail"),("Open cabinet","landing_cabinet"),("Try nursery door","landing_door")],
1617        "nursery":[("Inspect cradle","nursery_cradle"),("Read child's diary","nursery_diary"),("Wind music box","nursery_music"),("Check window","nursery_window")],
1618        "greenhouse":[("Search workbench","greenhouse_tools"),("Adjust pipes","greenhouse_heat"),("Escape via roof","greenhouse_glass"),("Inspect roots","greenhouse_roots")],
1619        "chapel":[("Inspect altar","chapel_altar"),("Take candle","chapel_candle"),("Ring old bell","chapel_bell"),("Read prayer","chapel_prayer")],
1620        "crypt":[("Open sarcophagus","crypt_coffin"),("Take ritual page","crypt_page"),("Read names","crypt_names"),("Seal the tomb","crypt_seal")],
1621    }
1622    actions=choices[state["scene"]][:]
1623    if state["scene"]=="yard" and "Maintenance Log" in state["inventory"] and "victim_count" in state["clues"]:
1624        actions.append(("Confront the ghost","confront"))
1625    return actions

1628def draw_completed_action(rect):

1633    ink = (154, 66, 70)
1634    pygame.draw.line(SCREEN, ink, (rect.left + 9, rect.top + 9),
1635                     (rect.right - 9, rect.bottom - 9), 2)
1636    pygame.draw.line(SCREEN, ink, (rect.left + 9, rect.bottom - 9),
1637                     (rect.right - 9, rect.top + 9), 2)
1638    mark = pygame.Rect(rect.right - 51, rect.top + 4, 46, 19)
1639    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, (28, 15, 20), mark, border_radius=3)
1640    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, ink, mark, width=1, border_radius=3)
1641    draw_text(SCREEN, "USED", mark.x + 6, mark.y + 3, TINY, (223, 137, 141))

1644def draw_bottom(state, button_rects):
1645    panel(SCREEN, BOTTOM)
1646    draw_text(SCREEN, "EXPLORATION PANEL", BOTTOM.x+18, BOTTOM.y+15, FONT, CYAN)
1647
1648    info=pygame.Rect(BOTTOM.x+16,BOTTOM.y+36,305,90)
1649    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN,(11,27,38),info,border_radius=6)
1650    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN,LINE,info,1,border_radius=6)
1651    draw_text(SCREEN,"HOW TO SEARCH",info.x+12,info.y+9,TINY,GOLD)
1652    hint=state["hover_hint"] or "Move your mouse over the scene to find clues and interaction zones. Click objects in the artwork itself to investigate them."
1653    draw_wrapped(SCREEN,hint,pygame.Rect(info.x+12,info.y+28,info.width-24,48),SMALL,PALE,2,max_lines=3)
1654
1655    history_rect = pygame.Rect(BOTTOM.x+336, BOTTOM.y+18, 500, 108)
1656    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, (8, 20, 31), history_rect, border_radius=6)
1657    pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, LINE, history_rect, 1, border_radius=6)
1658    draw_text(SCREEN, "ROOM DECISIONS", history_rect.x+12, history_rect.y+10, TINY, GOLD)
1659
1660    actions = action_cards_for_scene(state)
1661    used_actions = [(label, action) for label, action in actions if decision_already_made(state, action)]
1662    mouse = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
1663    bw,bh,gap = 112,74,8
1664    start_x = history_rect.x + 12
1665    start_y = history_rect.y + 25
1666
1667    if not used_actions:
1668        empty_rect = pygame.Rect(history_rect.x+12, history_rect.y+30, history_rect.width-24, 62)
1669        pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, (11, 27, 38), empty_rect, border_radius=5)
1670        pygame.draw.rect(SCREEN, (40, 78, 103), empty_rect, 1, border_radius=5)
1671        draw_wrapped(SCREEN, "No decisions recorded here yet. Search the scene directly to reveal clues and add completed actions below.", pygame.Rect(empty_rect.x+10, empty_rect.y+10, empty_rect.width-20, empty_rect.height-12), SMALL, MUTED, 2, max_lines=3)
1672    else:
1673        for i, (label, action) in enumerate(used_actions[:4]):
1674            row = i // 4
1675            col = i % 4
1676            rect = pygame.Rect(start_x + col*(bw+gap), start_y + row*(bh+6), bw, bh)
1677            hovered = rect.collidepoint(mouse)
1678            button(SCREEN, rect, label, hovered, False, font=SMALL)
1679            draw_completed_action(rect)
1680            button_rects.append((rect, action))
1681
1682    rpaths=pygame.Rect(BOTTOM.right-145,BOTTOM.y+34,125,26)
1683    rmap=pygame.Rect(BOTTOM.right-145,BOTTOM.y+64,125,26)
1684    rback=pygame.Rect(BOTTOM.right-145,BOTTOM.y+94,125,28)
1685    if state["game_over"]:
1686        button(SCREEN,rpaths,"PLAY AGAIN",rpaths.collidepoint(mouse),True,font=SMALL)
1687        button_rects.append((rpaths,"restart"))
1688    else:
1689        button(SCREEN,rpaths,"PATHS",rpaths.collidepoint(mouse),True,font=SMALL)
1690        button(SCREEN,rmap,"MAP",rmap.collidepoint(mouse),True,font=SMALL)
1691        button(SCREEN,rback,"BACK",rback.collidepoint(mouse),True,font=SMALL)
1692        button_rects.append((rpaths,"paths"))
1693        button_rects.append((rmap,"map"))
1694        button_rects.append((rback,"back"))

1696def draw_routes(state):
1697    """Modal path chooser. Every row is independently clickable without costs."""

1918def draw_game_over(state):
1919    overlay = pygame.Surface((W,H), pygame.SRCALPHA)

1921    SCREEN.blit(overlay,(0,0))
1922    rect = pygame.Rect(230, 230, 820, 300)

1924    title = state.get("ending_title") or ("GAME OVER" if state["health"] <= 0 else "ENDING")
1925    img = BIG.render(title, True, RED if state["health"] <= 0 else GOLD)
1926    SCREEN.blit(img, (rect.centerx-img.get_width()//2, rect.y+34))

1928    y = rect.y+105
1929    for line in lines[:6]:
1930        img = FONT.render(line, True, PALE)
1931        SCREEN.blit(img, (rect.centerx-img.get_width()//2,y))
1932        y += 27

1934    button(SCREEN,restart_rect,"RETURN TO MAIN MENU",restart_rect.collidepoint(pygame.mouse.get_pos()),True,SMALL)
1935    BUTTON_RECTS.append((restart_rect,"restart"))

1937STATE = None
1938MODE = "title"
1939SELECTED = None
1940BUTTON_RECTS = []
1941CHAR_CARDS = []
1942MENU_BUTTONS = []
1943INVENTORY_BUTTONS = []
1944ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS = []
1945ROUTE_BUTTONS = []
1946MAP_BUTTONS = []
1947
1948def main():
1949    global STATE, MODE, SELECTED, BUTTON_RECTS, CHAR_CARDS, MENU_BUTTONS, INVENTORY_BUTTONS, ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS, ROUTE_BUTTONS, MAP_BUTTONS
1950    running=True
1951    while running:
1952        dt=CLOCK.tick(FPS)/1000.0
1953        SCENE_AUDIO.update(dt)
1954        for event in pygame.event.get():
1955            if event.type==pygame.QUIT:
1956                running=False
1957            elif event.type==pygame.KEYDOWN:
1958                if event.key==pygame.K_ESCAPE:
1959                    if MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("map_open"):
1960                        STATE["map_open"] = False
1961                    elif MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("navigation_open"):
1962                        STATE["navigation_open"]=False
1963                    elif MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("encounter") is None:
1964                        MODE="title"; STATE=None; SCENE_AUDIO.stop()
1965                    elif MODE=="prologue":
1966                        MODE="confirm"
1967                    elif MODE=="confirm":
1968                        MODE="select"
1969                    elif MODE=="select":
1970                        MODE="title"
1971                    else:
1972                        running=False
1973                elif event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_RETURN) and MODE=="prologue" and SELECTED:
1974                    STATE=new_game(SELECTED); MODE="game"; play_sfx()
1975                elif event.key==pygame.K_m:
1976                    SCENE_AUDIO.toggle_mute()
1977                elif event.key==pygame.K_TAB and MODE=="game" and STATE and not STATE["game_over"] and not STATE.get("encounter"):
1978                    perform_action(STATE,"map");play_sfx()
1979                elif event.key==pygame.K_SPACE and MODE=="game" and STATE and not STATE["game_over"] and not STATE.get("encounter"):
1980                    perform_action(STATE,"paths");play_sfx()
1981            elif event.type==pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button==1:
1982                if MODE=="title":
1983                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
1984                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1985                            if action=="quit":running=False
1986                            elif action=="select":MODE="select"
1987                            play_sfx();break
1988                elif MODE=="select":
1989                    handled=False
1990                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
1991                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1992                            MODE=action;play_sfx();handled=True;break
1993                    if not handled:
1994                        for rect,name in CHAR_CARDS:
1995                            if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1996                                SELECTED=name;MODE="confirm";play_sfx();break
1997                elif MODE=="confirm":
1998                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
1999                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2000                            if action=="start" and SELECTED:
2001                                MODE="prologue"
2002                            elif action=="select":MODE="select"
2003                            play_sfx();break
2004                elif MODE=="prologue":
2005                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
2006                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2007                            if action=="begin" and SELECTED:
2008                                STATE=new_game(SELECTED); MODE="game"
2009                            elif action=="confirm":
2010                                MODE="confirm"
2011                            play_sfx(); break
2012                elif MODE=="game" and STATE:
2013                    if STATE["game_over"]:
2014                        for rect,action in BUTTON_RECTS:
2015                            if action=="restart" and rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2016                                SCENE_AUDIO.stop();STATE=None;MODE="title";play_sfx();break
2017                        continue
2018                    # Encounters are a modal: normal buttons and hotspots cannot
2019                    # be activated until the urgent choice is resolved.
2020                    if STATE.get("encounter") is not None:
2021                        for rect,idx in ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS:
2022                            if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2023                                encounter_choice(STATE,idx);play_sfx();break
2024                        continue
2025                    if STATE.get("map_open"):
2026                        for rect,action in MAP_BUTTONS:
2027                            if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2028                                perform_action(STATE,action);play_sfx();break
2029                        continue
2030                    if STATE.get("navigation_open"):
2031                        for rect,action in ROUTE_BUTTONS:
2032                            if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2033                                perform_action(STATE,action);play_sfx();break
2034                        continue
2035                    used=False
2036                    for rect,item in INVENTORY_BUTTONS:
2037                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2038                            use_item(STATE,item);play_sfx();used=True;break
2039                    if used:continue
2040                    for rect,action in BUTTON_RECTS:
2041                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2042                            perform_action(STATE,action);play_sfx();used=True;break
2043                    if used:continue
2044                    for spot in SCENES[STATE["scene"]]["hotspots"]:
2045                        x,y,w,h=spot["rect"]
2046                        rect=pygame.Rect(SCENE_RECT.x+x,SCENE_RECT.y+y,w,h)
2047                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2048                            perform_action(STATE,spot["action"]);play_sfx();break
2049        if MODE=="game" and STATE and not STATE["game_over"] and STATE.get("encounter_pending"):
2050            STATE["encounter_delay"]-=dt
2051            if STATE["encounter_delay"]<=1.8 and not STATE.get("encounter_warned"):
2052                STATE["encounter_warned"]=True
2053                if STATE.get("encounter_warning"):
2054                    set_feedback(STATE,"THE WATCHER IS NEAR",STATE["encounter_warning"],RED)
2055            if STATE["encounter_delay"]<=0:
2056                trigger_encounter(STATE,STATE["encounter_pending"])
2057        if MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("popup") and STATE["popup"].get("ttl",0)>0:
2058            STATE["popup"]["ttl"]-=1
2059        SCREEN.fill(INK)
2060        if MODE=="title":
2061            MENU_BUTTONS=draw_main_menu()
2062        elif MODE=="select":
2063            CHAR_CARDS,MENU_BUTTONS=draw_character_select()
2064        elif MODE=="confirm":
2065            MENU_BUTTONS=draw_character_confirm(SELECTED)
2066        elif MODE=="prologue":
2067            MENU_BUTTONS=draw_story_prologue(SELECTED)
2068        elif MODE=="game" and STATE:
2069            draw_header(STATE)
2070            INVENTORY_BUTTONS=[]
2071            draw_sidebar(STATE,INVENTORY_BUTTONS)
2072            draw_scene_background(STATE)
2073            draw_hotspots(STATE)
2074            draw_narrative(STATE)
2075            BUTTON_RECTS=[]
2076            draw_bottom(STATE,BUTTON_RECTS)
2077            if STATE["game_over"]:
2078                draw_game_over(STATE)
2079            elif STATE.get("encounter"):
2080                ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS=draw_encounter(STATE)
2081            else:
2082                ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS=[]
2083                if STATE.get("map_open"):
2084                    MAP_BUTTONS = draw_map_overlay(STATE)
2085                    ROUTE_BUTTONS=[]
2086                elif STATE.get("navigation_open"):
2087                    MAP_BUTTONS=[]
2088                    ROUTE_BUTTONS=draw_routes(STATE)
2089                else:
2090                    MAP_BUTTONS=[]
2091                    ROUTE_BUTTONS=[]
2092                    draw_popup(STATE)
2093        pygame.display.flip()
2094    SCENE_AUDIO.stop()
2095    pygame.quit()
2096    sys.exit()
2097
2098if __name__=="__main__":
2099    main()

class SceneAudio: 
192class SceneAudio:
193    """Crossfade distinct looped room ambience with independent SFX channels."""
194
195    FADE_SECONDS = 1.8
196    VOLUME = 0.67
197
198    def __init__(self):
199        self.enabled = AUDIO_ENABLED
200        self.channels = [pygame.mixer.Channel(4), pygame.mixer.Channel(5)] if self.enabled else []
201        self.music_channel = pygame.mixer.Channel(6) if self.enabled else None
202        self.active_slot = None
203        self.fading_slot = None
204        self.active_scene = None
205        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
206        self.muted = False
207
208    def enter(self, scene):
209        if not self.enabled or scene == self.active_scene:
210            return
211        sound = AMBIENCE.get(scene)
212        if self.music_channel is not None and MUSIC_BED is not None and not self.music_channel.get_busy():
213            self.music_channel.set_volume(0.0 if self.muted else 0.095)
214            self.music_channel.play(MUSIC_BED, loops=-1)
215        if sound is None:
216            self.stop()
217            return
218
219        next_slot = 0 if self.active_slot is None else 1 - self.active_slot
220        self.fading_slot = self.active_slot
221        self.active_slot = next_slot
222        self.active_scene = scene
223        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
224        channel = self.channels[next_slot]
225        channel.stop()
226        channel.set_volume(0.0)
227        channel.play(sound, loops=-1)
228
229        # For a fresh game, start the first room gently instead of abruptly.
230        if self.fading_slot is None:
231            self.fade_elapsed = 0.0
232
233    def update(self, seconds):
234        if self.active_slot is None:
235            return
236        self.fade_elapsed = min(self.FADE_SECONDS, self.fade_elapsed + seconds)
237        amount = self.fade_elapsed / self.FADE_SECONDS
238        target_volume = 0.0 if self.muted else self.VOLUME
239        if self.music_channel is not None:
240            self.music_channel.set_volume(0.0 if self.muted else 0.095)
241        self.channels[self.active_slot].set_volume(target_volume * amount)
242        if self.fading_slot is not None:
243            other = self.channels[self.fading_slot]
244            other.set_volume(target_volume * (1.0 - amount))
245            if amount >= 1.0:
246                other.stop()
247                self.fading_slot = None
248
249    def toggle_mute(self):
250        self.muted = not self.muted
251        # Apply the change immediately, including to sound being crossfaded.
252        self.update(0.0)
253
254    def stop(self):
255        for channel in self.channels:
256            channel.stop()
257        if self.music_channel is not None:
258            self.music_channel.stop()
259        self.active_slot = None
260        self.fading_slot = None
261        self.active_scene = None
262        self.fade_elapsed = 0.0

PROLOGUE_SHARED = 'Blackthorn Estate has stood empty since a fire swept through its east wing twenty-three years ago. The property was condemned; the last caretakers left without collecting their belongings. Yet over the past month, people have vanished along the road that runs past the iron gates. The police call it bad weather and bad luck. The townspeople call it a curse.'
PROLOGUE_PERSONAL = {'Marcus': "You came looking for your cousin Adrian, who disappeared while trying to photograph the abandoned house. His final message was only two words: 'Found something.' You brought your strength and the stubborn belief that, if he is still inside, you can get him out.", 'Evelyn': "You noticed a pattern in the missing-person reports: each name was linked to an old Blackthorn household record. Your research adviser dismissed the connection, then stopped replying to your messages. You've come to test your theory and find the evidence no one else saw.", 'Noah': 'An anonymous letter offered to pay you to restore power to a long-closed estate. Its diagrams showed an obsolete generator system you recognized, but the sender refused to give a name. You accepted the job for the money; now you suspect the broken machinery is the least of your problems.', 'Sofia': "Your friend Lena was last seen walking toward the Blackthorn service road. In her final voice message, she whispered that someone was moving among the trees without making a sound. You're not here for ghost stories. You're here because Lena would have looked for you."}
PROLOGUE_ARRIVAL = "Just before midnight, a violent storm swallows the road. Your engine stutters, the headlights dim, and the car rolls to a stop beside Blackthorn's open gate. There is no signal on your phone. Behind you, something moves among the pines. You have only a few moments to search the car before deciding whether to enter the estate."
def draw_text( surface, text, x, y, font=<pygame.font.Font object>, color=(208, 228, 238)): 
559def draw_text(surface, text, x, y, font=FONT, color=PALE):
560    surface.blit(font.render(str(text), True, color), (x, y))
def wrap_text(text, font, max_width): 
562def wrap_text(text, font, max_width):
563    words = text.split()
564    if not words:
565        return [""]
566    lines, line = [], ""
567    for word in words:
568        test = word if not line else line + " " + word
569        if font.size(test)[0] <= max_width:
570            line = test
571        else:
572            if line:
573                lines.append(line)
574            line = word
575    if line:
576        lines.append(line)
577    return lines
def draw_wrapped( surface, text, rect, font=<pygame.font.Font object>, color=(208, 228, 238), line_gap=3, max_lines=None): 
579def draw_wrapped(surface, text, rect, font=FONT, color=PALE, line_gap=3, max_lines=None):
580    y = rect.y
581    count = 0
582    for line in wrap_text(text, font, rect.width):
583        if max_lines is not None and count >= max_lines:
584            break
585        surface.blit(font.render(line, True, color), (rect.x, y))
586        y += font.get_linesize() + line_gap
587        count += 1
588    return y

592    pygame.draw.rect(surface, border, rect, 1, border_radius=radius)
def button( surface, rect, label, hovered=False, enabled=True, font=<pygame.font.Font object>): 
594def button(surface, rect, label, hovered=False, enabled=True, font=FONT):
595    fill = (15, 45, 59) if hovered else (7, 24, 35)
596    edge = CYAN if hovered else LINE
597    if not enabled:
598        fill, edge = (8, 15, 21), (43, 59, 66)
599    pygame.draw.rect(surface, fill, rect, border_radius=5)
600    pygame.draw.rect(surface, edge, rect, 1, border_radius=5)
601    lines = wrap_text(label, font, rect.width - 16)
602    total_h = len(lines) * font.get_linesize()
603    y = rect.centery - total_h // 2
604    for line in lines:
605        img = font.render(line, True, PALE if enabled else MUTED)
606        surface.blit(img, (rect.centerx - img.get_width() // 2, y))
607        y += font.get_linesize()

def perform_action(state, action): 
1062def perform_action(state,action):
1063    if state["game_over"] or state.get("encounter"):
1064        return
1065    if action in ("continue","paths","stairs"):
1066        state["navigation_open"]=True
1067        state["map_open"] = False
1068        state["popup"]=None
1069        return
1070    if action=="map":
1071        state["map_open"] = not state.get("map_open", False)
1072        state["navigation_open"] = False
1073        state["popup"] = None
1074        return
1075    if action=="back":
1076        state["map_open"] = False
1077        go_back(state)
1078        return
1079    if action=="close_paths":
1080        state["navigation_open"]=False
1081        return
1082    if action=="close_map":
1083        state["map_open"] = False
1084        return
1085    if action.startswith("route:"):
1086        use_route(state,action.split(":",1)[1])
1087        return
1088    # Existing door hotspots remain clickable, but traveling is free.
1089    if action in ("gate","dining","steeldoor"):
1090        use_route(state,{"gate":"hall","dining":"dining","steeldoor":"yard"}[action])
1091        return
1092    if action=="watch_killer":
1093        return
1094    # Check the persistent action registry BEFORE deducting a decision.
1095    if decision_already_made(state, action):
1096        show_decision_already_made(state, action)
1097        return
1098    oldscene,olddec=state["scene"],state["decisions"]
1099    act(state,action)
1100    after_player_action(state,oldscene,olddec,action)

def blit_cover(surface, image, rect): 
1466def blit_cover(surface, image, rect):
1467    iw, ih = image.get_size()
1468    scale = max(rect.width / iw, rect.height / ih)
1469    new_size = (max(1, int(iw * scale)), max(1, int(ih * scale)))
1470    scaled = pygame.transform.smoothscale(image, new_size)
1471    sx = max(0, (scaled.get_width() - rect.width) // 2)
1472    sy = max(0, (scaled.get_height() - rect.height) // 2)
1473    surface.blit(scaled, rect.topleft, area=pygame.Rect(sx, sy, rect.width, rect.height))

STATE = None
MODE = 'title'

ROUTE_BUTTONS = []

1950def main():
1951    global STATE, MODE, SELECTED, BUTTON_RECTS, CHAR_CARDS, MENU_BUTTONS, INVENTORY_BUTTONS, ENCOUNTER_BUTTONS, ROUTE_BUTTONS, MAP_BUTTONS
1952    running=True
1953    while running:
1954        dt=CLOCK.tick(FPS)/1000.0
1955        SCENE_AUDIO.update(dt)
1956        for event in pygame.event.get():
1957            if event.type==pygame.QUIT:
1958                running=False
1959            elif event.type==pygame.KEYDOWN:
1960                if event.key==pygame.K_ESCAPE:
1961                    if MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("map_open"):
1962                        STATE["map_open"] = False
1963                    elif MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("navigation_open"):
1964                        STATE["navigation_open"]=False
1965                    elif MODE=="game" and STATE and STATE.get("encounter") is None:
1966                        MODE="title"; STATE=None; SCENE_AUDIO.stop()
1967                    elif MODE=="prologue":
1968                        MODE="confirm"
1969                    elif MODE=="confirm":
1970                        MODE="select"
1971                    elif MODE=="select":
1972                        MODE="title"
1973                    else:
1974                        running=False
1975                elif event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_RETURN) and MODE=="prologue" and SELECTED:
1976                    STATE=new_game(SELECTED); MODE="game"; play_sfx()
1977                elif event.key==pygame.K_m:
1978                    SCENE_AUDIO.toggle_mute()
1979                elif event.key==pygame.K_TAB and MODE=="game" and STATE and not STATE["game_over"] and not STATE.get("encounter"):
1980                    perform_action(STATE,"map");play_sfx()
1981                elif event.key==pygame.K_SPACE and MODE=="game" and STATE and not STATE["game_over"] and not STATE.get("encounter"):
1982                    perform_action(STATE,"paths");play_sfx()
1983            elif event.type==pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button==1:
1984                if MODE=="title":
1985                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
1986                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1987                            if action=="quit":running=False
1988                            elif action=="select":MODE="select"
1989                            play_sfx();break
1990                elif MODE=="select":
1991                    handled=False
1992                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:
1993                        if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1994                            MODE=action;play_sfx();handled=True;break
1995                    if not handled:
1996                        for rect,name in CHAR_CARDS:
1997                            if rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
1998                                SELECTED=name;MODE="confirm";play_sfx();break
1999                elif MODE=="confirm":
2000                    for rect,action in MENU_BUTTONS:

2002                            if action=="start" and SELECTED:

2004                            elif action=="select":MODE="select"
2005                            play_sfx();break

2010                                STATE=new_game(SELECTED); MODE="game"
2011                            elif action=="confirm":
2012                                MODE="confirm"
2013                            play_sfx(); break
2014                elif MODE=="game" and STATE:
2015                    if STATE["game_over"]:
2016                        for rect,action in BUTTON_RECTS:
2017                            if action=="restart" and rect.collidepoint(event.pos):
2018                                SCENE_AUDIO.stop();STATE=None;MODE="title";play_sfx();break
2019                        continue
2020                    # Encounters are a modal: normal buttons and hotspots cannot
